originalTitle: Woman 'scared to turn heating on' due to oil cost
summary: Roslynn Garner-Gatley starts using a hot water bottle, bed socks and earlier bedtimes to stay warm.
content:
Roslynn Garner-Gatley says she relies entirely on oil for heating and hot water

A woman has said she is frightened to put her heating on because the cost of domestic oil has nearly doubled.

Roslynn Garner-Gatley, 76, lives in a three-bedroom semi-detached cottage in Yealmpton, south Devon, with no gas supply and relies entirely on oil for heating and hot water.

She said her oil tank held 1,000 litres (220 gallons). About six months earlier, she bought 500 litres (110 gallons) for £317 plus VAT but, when she contacted her supplier for a current quote, she was told the same amount would cost £600 plus VAT.

Garner-Gatley said: "I did not expect at my age after working for 50 years to be in a situation where I am terrified of putting on the heating because of the price of it."

The cost of filling her heating oil tank has nearly doubled

Garner-Gatley said she had started going to bed earlier to keep warm while watching television and had recently begun using a hot water bottle and bed socks as evening temperatures dropped.

She said instead of keeping hot water on a timer, she only switched it on when she needed it for washing, cooking or bathing before turning it off again.

She added that people living in rural areas who depended on oil had "no choice" but to buy it.

She said: "After working all my life I didn't expect to be constantly worrying about how to keep warm at my age. It is really quite frightening."

Heating fuel costs have risen by up to 82% since the start of the US-Israeli war with Iran, according to Minster for Energy Consumers Polly Billington.

Earlier in October, the government promised better regulation of the sector .

Ministers said they would tighten up rules, promote competition and give customers clearer compensation routes if things went wrong.

Minimum order levels set for some customers would also be reviewed, they added.

A spokesperson for the Department for Energy Security and Net Zero, said: "We have pledged £53m in support for vulnerable households on heating oil, while helping people switch to clean heat with Boiler Upgrade Scheme grants worth £9,000.

"We are also reforming the heating oil sector, holding suppliers to account and giving consumers confidence that they will get a fair deal."

Cornwall Council and Devon County Council have money available for households struggling with increasing heating oil costs from their crisis resilience funds, which are provided by the government.

Cornwall Council said it had issued payments of £300 to 1,386 households, a total spend of £415,800, which would double after a decision was made to award a further £300 to the same households.

The Devon fund, worth about £8.4m a year, is available through district councils, and is targeted at low‑income households facing an "essential cost they cannot afford".

Plymouth City Council and Torbay Council also have their own crisis resilience funds.

chineseTitle: 由于油价上涨，妇女“害怕打开暖气”
chineseSummary: 罗斯林·加纳-盖特利 (Roslynn Garner-Gatley) 开始使用热水袋、床袜和早睡来保暖。
chineseContent:
罗斯林·加纳·盖特利 (Roslynn Garner-Gatley) 表示，她完全依靠石油来取暖和提供热水

一名妇女表示，她不敢开暖气，因为国内石油的价格几乎翻了一番。

76 岁的罗斯林·加纳-盖特利 (Roslynn Garner-Gatley) 住在德文郡南部耶尔普顿 (Yealmpton) 的一座三卧室半独立小屋里，没有天然气供应，完全依靠石油取暖和提供热水。

她说她的油箱容量为 1,000 升（220 加仑）。大约六个月前，她以 317 英镑（含增值税）的价格购买了 500 升（110 加仑），但当她联系供应商获取最新报价时，她被告知同样数量的啤酒需花费 600 英镑（含增值税）。

加纳-盖特利说：“我没想到在我工作了 50 年的这个年纪，我会因为价格而害怕开暖气。”

加注取暖油箱的成本几乎翻了一番

加纳-盖特利说，她开始早点睡觉，一边看电视一边取暖，最近随着晚上气温下降，她开始使用热水袋和床袜。

她说，她没有在定时器上保留热水，而是只在需要洗涤、做饭或洗澡时才打开它，然后再将其关闭。

她补充说，生活在农村地区依赖石油的人们“别无选择”，只能购买石油。

她说：“工作了一辈子，没想到到了这个年纪，还要不断地担心如何保暖，真的很可怕。”

据能源消费者部长 Polly Billington 称，自美以与伊朗战争爆发以来，取暖燃料成本已上涨高达 82%。

十月初，政府承诺对该行业进行更好的监管。

部长们表示，如果出现问题，他们将收紧规则，促进竞争，并为客户提供更清晰的赔偿途径。

他们补充说，为某些客户设定的最低订单水平也将受到审查。

能源安全和净零部发言人表示：“我们已承诺向使用取暖油的弱势家庭提供 5300 万英镑的支持，同时通过价值 9,000 英镑的锅炉升级计划补助金帮助人们转向清洁供暖。

“我们还在改革取暖油行业，让供应商承担责任，并让消费者相信他们会得到公平的交易。”

康沃尔郡议会和德文郡议会通过政府提供的危机应对基金为因取暖油成本增加而苦苦挣扎的家庭提供资金。

康沃尔议会表示，已向 1,386 个家庭发放了 300 英镑的补助，总支出为 415,800 英镑，在决定向这些家庭再发放 300 英镑后，支出将增加一倍。

德文郡基金每年价值约 840 万英镑，可通过区议会获得，针对面临“无法承担的基本费用”的低收入家庭。

普利茅斯市议会和托贝议会也有自己的危机应对基金。
